#include<bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;
int n,m,r,c,d,occ[100];
pair<int,int>p[100];
namespace MCMF{
	const int N=10000,M=20000000;
	int head[N],cnt,dis[N],fr[N],id[N],S,T,cost;
	struct node{
		int to,next,val,cost;
	}edge[M];
	void ae(int u,int v,int w,int c){
		edge[cnt].cost=c,edge[cnt].next=head[u],edge[cnt].to=v,edge[cnt].val=w,head[u]=cnt++;
		edge[cnt].cost=-c,edge[cnt].next=head[v],edge[cnt].to=u,edge[cnt].val=0,head[v]=cnt++;
	}
	queue<int>q;
	bool in[N];
	bool SPFA(){
		memset(dis,0x3f,sizeof(dis)),dis[S]=0,q.push(S),in[S]=true;
		while(!q.empty()){
			int x=q.front();q.pop(),in[x]=false;
			for(int i=head[x];i!=-1;i=edge[i].next){
				if(!edge[i].val)continue;
				if(dis[edge[i].to]>dis[x]+edge[i].cost){
					dis[edge[i].to]=dis[x]+edge[i].cost,fr[edge[i].to]=x,id[edge[i].to]=i;
					if(!in[edge[i].to])in[edge[i].to]=true,q.push(edge[i].to);
				}
			}
		}
		if(dis[T]==dis[N-1])return false;
		int x=T,mn=0x3f3f3f3f;
		while(x!=S)mn=min(mn,edge[id[x]].val),x=fr[x];
		cost+=dis[T]*mn,x=T;
		while(x!=S)edge[id[x]].val-=mn,edge[id[x]^1].val+=mn,x=fr[x];
		return true;
	}
}
using namespace MCMF;
int main(){
	scanf("%d%d%d%d%d",&n,&m,&r,&c,&d),memset(head,-1,sizeof(head)),S=(r+n+1)*n+1,T=(r+n+1)*n+2;
	for(int i=1,x;i<=r;i++)scanf("%d",&x),occ[x]++;
	for(int i=1;i<=m;i++)scanf("%d%d",&p[i].first,&p[i].second);
	for(int i=0;i<r+n;i++)for(int j=1;j<=m;j++)for(int k=1;k<=r;k++)ae(i*n+p[j].first,(i+1)*n+p[j].second,1,(2*k-1)*d),ae(i*n+p[j].second,(i+1)*n+p[j].first,1,(2*k-1)*d);
	for(int i=1;i<=r+n;i++){
		ae(i*n+1,T,0x3f3f3f3f,i*c);
		for(int j=2;j<=n;j++)ae((i-1)*n+j,i*n+j,0x3f3f3f3f,0);
	}	
	for(int i=1;i<=n;i++)ae(S,i,occ[i],0);
	while(SPFA());
	printf("%d\n",cost);
	return 0;
}

import sys
import heapq

class MCMF:
    def __init__(self):
        self.N = 10000
        self.M = 20000000
        self.head = [-1] * self.N
        self.cnt = 0
        self.dis = [float('inf')] * self.N
        self.fr = [0] * self.N
        self.id = [0] * self.N
        self.S = self.N - 1
        self.T = self.N
        self.cost = 0

    def ae(self, u, v, w, c):
        self.edge[self.cnt] = {'to': v, 'next': self.head[u], 'val': w, 'cost': c}
        self.head[u] = self.cnt
        self.cnt += 1
        self.edge[self.cnt] = {'to': u, 'next': self.head[v], 'val': 0, 'cost': -c}
        self.head[v] = self.cnt
        self.cnt += 1

    def SPFA(self):
        self.dis = [float('inf')] * self.N
        self.dis[self.S] = 0
        self.q = []
        self.q.append(self.S)
        self.in = [False] * self.N
        self.in[self.S] = True
        while self.q:
            x = self.q.pop(0)
            self.in[x] = False
            for i in range(self.head[x], -1, -1):
                if not self.edge[i]['val']:
                    continue
                if self.dis[self.edge[i]['to']] > self.dis[x] + self.edge[i]['cost']:
                    self.dis[self.edge[i]['to']] = self.dis[x] + self.edge[i]['cost']
                    self.fr[self.edge[i]['to']] = x
                    self.id[self.edge[i]['to']] = i
                    if not self.in[self.edge[i]['to']]:
                        self.in[self.edge[i]['to']] = True
                        self.q.append(self.edge[i]['to'])
        if self.dis[self.T] == self.dis[self.N - 1]:
            return False
        x = self.T
        mn = float('inf')
        while x != self.S:
            mn = min(mn, self.edge[self.id[x]]['val'])
            x = self.fr[x]
        self.cost += self.dis[self.T] * mn
        x = self.T
        while x != self.S:
            self.edge[self.id[x]]['val'] -= mn
            self.edge[self.id[x] ^ 1]['val'] += mn
            x = self.fr[x]
        return True

def main():
    n, m, r, c, d = map(int, input().split())
    MCMF = MCMF()
    MCMF.S = (r + n + 1) * n + 1
    MCMF.T = (r + n + 1) * n + 2
    occ = [0] * 100
    p = [[0, 0] for _ in range(100)]
    for i in range(1, r + 1):
        x = int(input())
        occ[x] += 1
    for i in range(1, m + 1):
        p[i][0], p[i][1] = map(int, input().split())
    for i in range(r + n):
        for j in range(1, m + 1):
            for k in range(1, r + 1):
                MCMF.ae(i * n + p[j][0], (i + 1) * n + p[j][1], 1, (2 * k - 1) * d)
                MCMF.ae(i * n + p[j][1], (i + 1) * n + p[j][0], 1, (2 * k - 1) * d)
    for i in range(1, r + n + 1):
        MCMF.ae(i * n + 1, MCMF.T, float('inf'), i * c)
        for j in range(2, n + 1):
            MCMF.ae((i - 1) * n + j, i * n + j, float('inf'), 0)
    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        MCMF.ae(MCMF.S, i, occ[i], 0)
    while MCMF.SPFA()
    print(MCMF.cost)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
